title: Idleness is Relative: Exploiting Tool-Call Idle Windows for Offloading in Agentic Systems with MORI
authors: Tian Xia; Hanchen Li; Zhifei Li; Xiaokun Chen; Hao Kang; Yifan Qiao; Yi Xu; Ion Stoica
affiliations: UC Berkeley, Renmin University of China, Stanford University, Georgia Institute of Technology
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Agentic sessions issue tens of model invocations interleaved with tool calls, accumulating KV cache that exceeds GPU HBM capacity and must be offloaded to CPU DRAM. Tool-call durations span orders of magnitude and are unknown until completion, so re-placing entries on every call is impractical; LRU and binary busy/idle labels misalign with the fixed GPU-to-CPU capacity ratio, leaving one tier underutilized while the other is oversubscribed.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic session 會發出數十次 model 呼叫並穿插 tool call，累積的 KV cache 容易超過 GPU HBM 容量，因而需 offload 至 CPU DRAM。然而 tool call 時長橫跨多個數量級且完成前無從得知，逐次搬移 KV cache 並不可行；LRU 與二元 busy/idle 分類皆無法對齊固定的 GPU-to-CPU 容量比，導致一層記憶體閒置而另一層超載。

key_innovation.en: MORI treats idleness as a continuous, relative spectrum: a windowed idleness metric (fraction of recent time spent in tool calls over the last k=5 inference-tool-call cycles) ranks all active programs; the busiest are placed in GPU HBM and the most idle in CPU DRAM, with the partition boundary shifting dynamically to match hardware capacity. Sticky placement avoids churn, three-tier queues (GPU/CPU/Waiting) enforce admission control at each tier, and affinity-aware load balancing routes requests across replicas to preserve cached KV state.
key_innovation.zh: MORI 將 idleness 視為連續且相對的光譜：以視窗化 idleness 指標（最近 k=5 個 inference–tool-call 週期中 tool call 時間佔比）對所有活躍 program 排序，最忙者置於 GPU HBM、最閒者置於 CPU DRAM，分界隨硬體容量動態調整。並藉由 sticky placement 避免反覆搬移、以三層佇列（GPU/CPU/Waiting）在各層實施 admission control，且在多 replica 間以 affinity-aware load balancing 保留既有 KV cache 局部性。

key_improvements.en: 20-71% higher output throughput and 18-43% lower TTFT than the best offloading baseline (ThunderAgent+Offloading) at 80 concurrent programs; 1.6-2.1x higher throughput than non-offloading systems; in multi-replica (DP=3) deployment, 54-79% higher throughput while sustaining 99%+ GPU utilization.
key_improvements.zh: 在 80 個並行 program 下，相較最佳 offloading baseline（ThunderAgent+Offloading）輸出 throughput 提升 20–71%、TTFT 降低 18–43%；較無 offloading 的系統 throughput 高 1.6–2.1x；多 replica（DP=3）部署下 throughput 提升 54–79%，同時維持 99%+ 的 GPU 利用率。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H200, NVIDIA B200, HBM, DRAM
offload_trigger: Periodic scheduler control loop (default 5s tick) detecting GPU-tier capacity violation: when aggregate KV cache of GPU-queue programs exceeds HBM capacity, programs are demoted until usage fits; placement is otherwise sticky.
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive: a program returning from its tool call is gated until the scheduler promotes it back to the GPU queue when capacity allows, lowest-idleness programs first; reload is a CPU-to-GPU PCIe transfer with cache affinity to the replica that computed it. No tool-call-duration prediction.
agent_awareness: Exploits tool-call idle windows and the busy/idle structure of agentic programs: each agent session is tracked as a program across its lifetime, with a windowed relative-idleness metric over the last k=5 inference/tool-call cycles; subagent spawning is treated as one long tool call.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Offload only when the aggregate KV cache of GPU-resident programs exceeds HBM capacity; then demote the programs with the highest windowed relative idleness (preferring Acting over Reasoning programs) to CPU DRAM until usage fits, otherwise keep placement unchanged (sticky placement).
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 僅當 GPU 常駐 programs 的 KV cache 總量超出 HBM 容量時才卸載；此時依 windowed relative idleness（優先選擇 Acting 而非 Reasoning 的 programs）由高至低將 programs 卸載至 CPU DRAM，直至符合容量限制；否則維持既有配置（sticky placement）。
